title: viborgia austriaca
intro: Viborgia austriaca, commonly known as Austrian blue violet, is a flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. The health benefits of Viborgia austriaca include its use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help soothe skin irritations and reduce swelling. The plant is also believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anxiolytic and antispasmodic properties, making it potentially useful for stress relief and muscle relaxation. Bioactive constituents present in Viborgia austriaca include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
